rows.text: Jawbone quality varies from patient to patient. When bone quality is poorer, additional implants may be required to provide long-term stability and durability of the bridge. rows.text: The whitening process

The trays containing the whitening gel are worn as instructed by your dentist, usually overnight and for three hours during the day. During this period, you should avoid foods and drinks that can stain your teeth, such as coffee, tea and red wine, as well as smoking. rows.text: Implant-retained dentures

Implant-retained dentures, secured to implants either directly or via a bar, remain stable when chewing and speaking. They provide greater stability and confidence when chewing than conventional removable dentures, with function closer to that of natural teeth. The forces transmitted through the implants stimulate the bone in the lower jaw, reducing bone resorption often associated with conventional removable dentures.

Pterygoid implants can be placed in areas of the upper jaw where there is often insufficient bone for conventional implants.
